body:
Linux batch gate on aa071242 (the feat commit): green - geometry, cl, tools, post, sim (181 s), motion (203 s), app (821 s), ui (98 s) suites and clippy -D warnings, 9/9 steps, 0 failed, 22.2 min wall. Local: the touched suites (sim plasma_laws 15, plasma_program 5; motion plasma::tests 12; app plasma_gate 4, plasma_machine 6, plasma_profile 7, post_not_judged 4) and clippy on sim/motion/app, plus the remove-the-refusal table in the body.

Pushed bb76bbbc after the gate: a test-header-only change (names `app::posting_plasma` and `app::machine::plasma` in plasma_gate's gate map, so the quick gate routes the new module to its suite - it read 0 suites before). No code change; the gate result above speaks for the code.

Back to draft: the review above found two blockers in the plasma geometry (tip-up and cut-crossing go quiet on through-vertex and collinear-edge contacts, `geom.rs` `crosses_area` / `rings_cross`). Fixes go on this branch; flag ready again once they are pinned.

Review findings fixed in de388c32 (still a draft).

**Blocker 1 - tip-up through a ring vertex** (`geom.rs::crosses_area`): the rapid is split at every contact with the freed part's ring (a proper crossing, a vertex it passes through, the ends of a stretch along an edge) and judged piece by piece - a piece whose midpoint lies strictly inside is a tip-up, reported at that midpoint. The departure exemption falls out of it (every piece outside); a rapid that leaves the edge and then crosses the part does not. Pinned by `plasma_laws::a_rapid_through_a_freed_parts_corner_is_a_tip_up`: the three review fixtures (50,25)→(-50,-25), (0,0)→(70,70), (-10,-10)→(70,70) each warn with `at` inside the part; a rapid along the bottom edge stays clear.

**Blocker 2 - cut crossing of rings touching only at vertices or collinear edges** (`geom.rs::rings_cross`): after the proper-crossing scan, a later ring with a piece strictly inside the earlier ring and a piece strictly outside it is refused (same edge split, on every edge of the later ring - stronger than sampling vertices and midpoints, which misses an edge in at one vertex and out at another). Pinned by `plasma_laws::an_overlapping_ring_meeting_only_at_vertices_and_edges_is_refused`: `square(0,0,50)` then `square(25,0,50)` is a `CutCrossing` refusal; `square(50,0,50)` (shared edge, common-line cutting) stays a kerf-crossing warning only.

**Cover law - sharp inside corners (decided by the main session, recorded as decision 4a):** every inside corner leaves a kerf-radius tip the torch cannot reach, so `cover_law` exempts each inside corner's tip zone and judges only the material beyond it. The zone is r (tan(δ/2) − √3) along each wall from the vertex (δ the turn; the stretch even the ideal miter path leaves beyond 2r), empty for openings of 60° and more, 1.5 mm at 30°. Pinned by `plasma::tests::a_sharp_inside_corner_generates_with_its_tip_left_not_refused` (30°, 45°, 55° V-notches 20 mm wide generate); the 1 mm notch and 1 mm keyway are still refused and the 3 mm notch still cuts (`a_slot_narrower_than_the_kerf_is_refused_not_bridged`). The refusal now names the gap: `a slot, notch or keyway about 1.000 mm across, narrower than the kerf (1.500 mm), is bridged by the offset, not cut; widen it past the kerf or use a narrower kerf`.

**Remove-the-fix:** `crosses_area` back to endpoint-inside-or-proper-crossing → the corner test FAILS (3 other sim pins pass); `rings_cross` back to proper-only → the overlapping-ring test FAILS; `tip_zone` returning 0 → the V-notch test FAILS with the 30° notch refused again, while the slot/keyway test still passes (the zone is empty at 90°). Sources restored after each (the tree is at the commit).

**Also:** PR title made conventional; the body's mutation table now lists the three `plasma_gate` tests the gate-wiring mutation fails and the new rows; the "only OUTER cuts are freed" tip-up note and the inch / G41-G42 gate pins are follow-up #801.

**Tests (local, debug):** sim `plasma_laws` 17/17, `plasma_program` 5/5; motion `plasma::tests` 13/13; app `plasma_gate` 4/4, `plasma_machine` 6/6, `plasma_profile` 7/7, `post_not_judged` 4/4, `conformance` 6/6, `golden_cl` 24/24; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. Linux batch gate running on de388c32; result to follow.
Linux batch gate on de388c32: green - geometry, cl, tools, post, sim (126 s), motion (129 s), app (572 s), ui (63 s) suites and clippy -D warnings all ok; 9 steps, 0 failed, 15.2 min wall.

Delta-review fixes pushed: 40f256b4 (`fix(sim,motion): a part inside an earlier one touching its edge crosses it; cap the corner tip zone at a kerf`).

**1. `rings_cross` (sim `verify/plasma/geom.rs`).** A later ring now crosses an earlier one when it has a piece strictly inside it, unless the later ring is wholly and strictly enclosed: `if outside || !encloses(b, a) { within } else { None }`. So E = square(0,0,50) then L = [0,25]×[0,50] is a CutCrossing refusal, placed inside E. It used to get only a KerfCrossing warning. Shared edges and a hole that touches its outline at a vertex (cut first) have no piece strictly inside, so they stay legal.
- Pin: `a_ring_inside_an_earlier_part_touching_its_edge_is_refused` (sim `plasma_laws`). It covers E then L refused, and a diamond hole touching the outline at a vertex, cut first, with no CutCrossing.
- The existing shared-edge pin (`an_overlapping_ring_meeting_only_at_vertices_and_edges_is_refused`) stays green.

**2. `tip_zone` (motion `plasma/laws.rs`).** The exempt length r(tan(δ/2) − √3) is now capped at one kerf width, 2r. A non-finite tan also takes the cap. The 30° zone is exactly 1.5 mm, so the 30°, 45° and 55° V-notches keep their zones and still generate.
- Pin: `a_deep_narrow_wedge_is_refused_not_exempted_as_a_corner_tip` (motion `plasma::tests`). With the 1.5 mm kerf, the 4° × 20 mm, 2° × 40 mm and 10° × 5 mm wedges are each refused by name.

**Gap message (non-blocking note).** When the uncovered edge has inside corners at both ends (a slot floor), the reported gap is now the smaller of the nearest non-adjacent edge and the floor's own length. A point on the floor now reports the slot's width, not its depth.

Decision 4a and the cut-crossing entry in `docs/decisions/672-plasma-laws-2.md` are updated.

**Remove-the-fix check:**
- Reverting the `rings_cross` line makes the new sim pin fail with `[KerfCrossing { contour: 2, earlier: 1, .. }]`.
- Reverting the cap makes the new motion pin fail: the 4° × 20 mm wedge generates with no error.

**Gate:**
- Locally: sim `plasma_laws` (18) and `plasma_program` (5), motion `plasma::tests` (14), and app `plasma_gate` (4), `plasma_profile` (7), `conformance` (6) and `golden_cl` (24) all pass. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.
- Linux quick gate on 40f256b4: green, 0 failed (sim, motion and app suites).

Left as a draft for the main session to re-ready.
